clue.text: Four American suits attractive, not half, for sailor

parts.note: a deck of cards holds all four suits; deck is the American word for a pack

indicators.note: only half the word for attractive is kept, its second half dropped

parts.note: handsome means good-looking

explanation.surface: An odd shopping list of American suits and good looks, somehow adding up to a man at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suits' looks like clothing, but these are the four card suits that make up a full deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A deckhand is a crew member who does manual work on a ship, so a sailor.

clue.text: Short stay in sleazy bar turns out to be inharmonious

indicators.note: in places the shortened stay inside the word for a sleazy bar

parts.note: a dive is a disreputable drinking place

indicators.note: short means the word for a stay is cut off before its final letter

parts.note: a visit is a short stay somewhere

explanation.surface: A brief visit to a seedy bar proves to be a discordant experience.
explanation.definitionFit: Something divisive causes disagreement and discord, so it is far from harmonious.

clue.text: Name a poisonous plant

parts.note: to call someone something is to name them
taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to identify a toxic plant, like a botany quiz question.
explanation.definitionFit: The calla, or arum lily, is a plant whose sap and leaves are toxic.

clue.text: Chief group supplying item of audio equipment

parts.note: the head is the person in charge
a set is a collection of things or people

explanation.surface: The boss's team is providing the sound kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A headset is a pair of headphones, often with a microphone, worn for listening.

clue.text: Settled in home, good person no longer appearing in poverty

indicators.note: the good person is taken out of the word for settled in home

parts.note: a bird nested when it settled into its home
ST, short for saint, is the crossword's good person

explanation.surface: A tale of someone comfortably housed until a kindly figure disappears and hardship sets in.
explanation.definitionFit: Need is a state of lacking the basic necessities, a synonym for hardship and want.

clue.text: Feasts with son, yawning at first

indicators.note: the word for yawning comes first, with the son after it

parts.note: agape means wide open, like a yawning mouth
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A banquet with a boy who starts off yawning.
explanation.definitionFit: An agape was an early Christian love feast, a communal meal shared by believers.

clue.text: Food with fancy choc — gin swilled to swallow it

indicators.note: the reworked gin takes the reworked choc inside it
swilled means sloshed about, so the letters of gin are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: fancy here means elaborately reworked, so choc's letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A dessert where chocolate is washed down with gin.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnocchi are small Italian dumplings, usually of potato, eaten as a dish.

clue.text: A previous actor?

parts.note: per means a, as in so much per day
former means earlier or previous

explanation.surface: A question about a former thespian, someone who used to tread the boards.
explanation.walkthrough: PER = a, as in fifty pence per item. The surface suggests a retired actor; actually 'A previous' builds the word and 'actor' defines it.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor is someone who plays a role on stage or screen, so a performer.

clue.text: Wearing a band and unhappy, the female being kept in

indicators.note: the female is held inside the word for unhappy

parts.note: sad means unhappy
she is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A woman in a sash, miserable at being confined.
explanation.definitionFit: Sashed describes someone with a sash, a wide ribbon or band, across their body.

clue.text: Nasty non-English beers for community members

indicators.note: the English letter is removed from the word for nasty

parts.note: vile means nasty
lagers are light beers

explanation.surface: Locals in a pub complaining about horrible foreign beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Villagers are the inhabitants of a village, members of a small rural community.

clue.text: Hindu god on cut grass causing row in the Bible belt?

parts.note: Shiva is one of the principal Hindu deities

indicators.note: cut means the word for grass loses its last letter

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass of wet places

explanation.surface: An Indian deity sitting on a mown lawn causes a commotion in the American South.
explanation.walkthrough: The Bible belt is the conservative Protestant region of the southern US, where this word is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A shivaree is a noisy mock serenade made with pans and kettles, an American term for a raucous din.

clue.text: Monsters among lesser gods repulsed

indicators.note: repulsed means driven back, so the found letters are read backwards
among says the letters lie within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters sit across the end of lesser and the start of gods

explanation.surface: Fearsome creatures driven off by minor deities.
explanation.definitionFit: Ogres are man-eating giants of folklore, archetypal monsters.

clue.text: Thin poles collapse finally

parts.note: spars are poles used as masts or booms on a ship

indicators.note: finally picks out the closing letter of collapse

parts.note: its final letter is the one taken

explanation.surface: Flimsy poles eventually fall down.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparse means thinly scattered, as in sparse hair or sparse vegetation.

clue.text: Reveal situation with a cathedral adjacent to Hell?

indicators.note: the cathedral word sits right beside the word for Hell, after it

parts.note: Dis is the Roman underworld, and Dante's city of Hell
a close is the enclosed precinct around a cathedral

explanation.surface: A question about a holy place sitting next door to the inferno.
explanation.definitionFit: To disclose is to make known or expose information, a synonym for reveal.

clue.text: The fourth item given legal status

parts.note: an article is an item or object
D is the fourth letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A legal document whose fourth clause confers official standing.
explanation.definitionFit: Articled describes a trainee bound by formal articles of agreement, as a clerk to a solicitor.

clue.text: Serving a meat. I abandoned … this?

definitions.text: Serving a meat. I abandoned … this?

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the preceding letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: these thirteen letters are the fodder, used as written

explanation.surface: Someone describing the moment they dished up a meat course and then gave up meat for good.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does both jobs: the letters of the first four words are mixed, and the clue as a whole describes giving up meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Vegetarianism is the practice of not eating meat, the diet one adopts on renouncing it.

clue.text: Cut more out-of-date fuel container

parts.note: a gash is a deep cut
older means more aged or dated

explanation.surface: A tank for fuel that is slashed and even more antiquated.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasholder is a large storage tank for town gas, also called a gasometer.

clue.text: Object of travel? Four years for a president, say

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the end station or destination of a journey

definitions.text: Four years for a president, say
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as three words: a four-year term in the US

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as TERM IN US: a president serves a four-year term in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminus is the final stop of a route, the goal a journey aims at, and the split gives a presidential term in America.

clue.text: Extra payment church wanted after worship — terrible rage!

indicators.note: the church letters are placed after the word for worship

parts.note: a service is an act of public worship

indicators.note: terrible means awful, so the letters of rage are scrambled

parts.note: used as written, as the fodder to rearrange

explanation.surface: After the worship, the church wanting money provokes a furious outburst.
explanation.definitionFit: A service charge is an additional sum added to a bill, as in a restaurant.

clue.text: Name of London street with a buried chemical

indicators.note: the letter a is buried inside the street's name

parts.note: Regent Street is a famous shopping street in London's West End
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dangerous substance buried beneath a well-known London road.
explanation.definitionFit: A reagent is a substance used to bring about or detect a chemical reaction.

clue.text: Head of harems has various ladies in compounds

indicators.note: head of means the first letter of harems

parts.note: its opening letter is the one taken

indicators.note: various suggests diversity, so the letters of ladies are mixed

parts.note: used as written, as the fodder to rearrange

explanation.surface: The chief of a harem keeps an assortment of women within walled enclosures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compounds' suggests enclosed living quarters, fitting the harem picture; it is the chemistry sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Halides are chemical compounds of a halogen with another element, such as sodium chloride.

clue.text: Expert educationist is smeared

parts.note: a dab, or dab hand, is a skilled person
a BEd, Bachelor of Education, is a teacher's degree, so its holder is an educationist

explanation.surface: A skilled teacher has been covered in muck.
explanation.definitionFit: Dabbed means applied with light strokes, as paint or ointment is daubed on.

clue.text: A piece of furniture keeps operating — not beyond redemption

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: keeps means holds within, so the word for operating goes inside

parts.note: a table is an item of furniture
on means working or switched on

explanation.surface: An old piece of furniture is still working, so it can be salvaged.
explanation.definitionFit: Atonable means capable of being atoned for, so the wrong can be made amends for.

clue.text: See penetrating hit in race

indicators.note: the word for see is pushed into the word for hit

parts.note: to slam is to hit hard
lo is an old word meaning look or see

explanation.surface: Watching something break through a blow during a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: A slalom is a downhill ski race weaving between poles.

clue.text: Lord, say, in act of deception

indicators.note: in means the example abbreviation sits inside the word for deception

parts.note: a lie is an untruth told to deceive
eg, for example, is what say means here

explanation.surface: A nobleman, for instance, caught in a deceit.
explanation.definitionFit: A liege is a feudal superior to whom allegiance is owed, a lord.

clue.text: Bad and upsettingly relevant

indicators.note: in a down clue, upsetting turns the word upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: live means current and relevant, as in a live issue

explanation.surface: Something wicked that is disturbingly pertinent.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil means morally wrong or wicked, a strong synonym of bad.

clue.text: Stir created by No.11's action unending

indicators.note: unending means the last letter is lost

parts.note: 11 Downing Street is the Chancellor of the Exchequer's residence, and the budget is the Chancellor's yearly statement

explanation.surface: A fuss stirred up by the Chancellor's annual financial plans.
explanation.definitionFit: To budge is to move or shift slightly, as in refusing to stir from a spot.

clue.text: Picture man, keen learner, being entertained by university official

indicators.note: the keen learner is held inside the official, like a guest

parts.note: a dean is a senior college administrator
avid means keen or eager
L is the learner sign on a British car

explanation.surface: An eager student invited in by a college official to discuss films.
explanation.definitionFit: David Lean was the British film director of Lawrence of Arabia and Brief Encounter, a man who made movies.

clue.text: Reduce the charges once banker implicates snitch

indicators.note: implicates is read as folds in, so the river wraps round the informer

parts.note: a banker is a river, something with banks; the Dee is a British river
a rat is an informer

explanation.surface: Lowering costs after a bank worker drags an informer into the scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: Rates were the old British local property tax; derating once meant relieving property of them. 'Banker' points to a financier, but it is a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To derate was to reduce or remove the rates, local taxes, levied on property.

clue.text: Gets agitated and rests irregularly after illness

indicators.note: the reworked word follows the word for illness

parts.note: flu is a common illness

indicators.note: irregularly means unevenly, so the letters of rests are jumbled

parts.note: used as written, as the fodder to rearrange

explanation.surface: A convalescent getting worked up while resting in fits and starts after flu.
explanation.definitionFit: Flusters means becomes nervous or confused, so gets flustered and agitated.
